purpose: Product truth artifact. Distinguishes source/test evidence from runtime evidence. Nothing here is RUNTIME_VERIFIED: that requires live-environment evidence that unit/contract tests cannot provide.

rules: status=TESTED_LOCAL means automated tests pass locally; it is not runtime evidence.
ci is CI_PENDING until a GitHub run on the exact commit is observed.
runtimeQualification is RUNTIME_VERIFIED only with live-environment evidence recorded in the repository.

capabilities.knownLimitation: No real embedding server (Ollama/vLLM/llama.cpp) has been run: only an in-process fake transport. Semantic candidates are a bounded brute-force window (RETRIEVAL_SEMANTIC_SCAN_LIMIT, default 1000 newest same-model rows per workspace), not an ANN index.

capabilities.runtimePath: MySQL-backed durable tasks: server/tasks (store, worker), tRPC tasks.get/list/cancel; leases + attempt fencing, checkpoint/resume, bounded retry, durable cancel, idempotent create, effect dedupe, Provider Gateway-governed model calls; server-wired worker runtime (server/tasks/runtime.ts, default OFF via TASK_WORKER_ENABLED) executing one workflow, chat.answer, via tRPC chat.sendAsync
capabilities.knownLimitation: Verified on local MariaDB 10.11 only (MySQL 8 CI pending; no GitHub CI observed). The worker runtime is wired into server startup/shutdown and /readyz but is OFF by default; exactly one workflow (chat.answer via chat.sendAsync) is enqueued; synchronous chat.send is unchanged. No client UI uses sendAsync yet. Not exercised against a live deployment or a real model. Side effects are at-least-once with durable dedupe records; handlers must use idempotent operations. Cancellation of a running task is cooperative (next checkpoint/effect). A shutdown that exceeds the grace period abandons in-flight tasks; they resume after lease expiry.

capabilities.runtimePath: Governed READ-ONLY MCP (Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC) connector: server/connectors/mcp (policy, client, store, service), tRPC connectors.mcp.*; workspace-owned, disabled by default, operator-approved endpoints only, explicit readOnlyHint required, mutation-looking tools denied, bounded time/bytes, schema-validated, redacted, provenance + audit
capabilities.knownLimitation: Exercised only against a deterministic in-process fake MCP server; no real MCP server, no OAuth-protected MCP servers, no stdio transport (deliberately unsupported). Wired (default OFF, MCP_CHAT_TOOLS_ENABLED) into the durable chat.answer path only (one read-only call per answer, provenance in the citation); synchronous chat.send and the brain/agent orchestrator do not use it. See docs/MCP_CHAT_TOOLS.md. Name-based mutation heuristics are conservative (false positives such as get_order are denied). Secrets are resolved from MCP_SECRET_<REF> environment variables.

capabilities.runtimePath: Backend-only resumable chunked ingestion: tRPC files.resumable.{begin,putChunk,status,finalize,abort}; chunks live only in the fileUploadChunks quarantine table; finalize = assemble -> size/checksum -> shape -> malware scan -> clean decision -> extraction -> normal storage (object store + documents + chunks). Infected = terminal reject + purge; scanner unavailable = fail closed, bytes stay quarantined, retryable. Default OFF (FILE_INGESTION_BACKEND_ENABLED); the owner-approval gate keeps the upload UI disabled
capabilities.knownLimitation: Verified on local MariaDB 10.11 with a stub scanner and an in-process clamd INSTREAM fake; no real ClamAV and no real S3. No client uses it and the upload UI remains gated. Max 12 MiB per file (assembled in memory), 128 KiB chunks. A bounded cleanup runner is wired but OFF by default. Quarantine bytes sit in the application database (mediumblob) until purge. Cleanup runner: OFF by default, single-flight per process, verified on MariaDB only, not run against a live deployment. Client upload UI intentionally unchanged (Coming Soon).

capabilities.runtimePath: pnpm test:recovery: logical backup (consistent snapshot, per-table count + SHA-256) -> restore into an empty throwaway database -> verification; old-schema backup upgraded to latest via forward migrations; searchText backfill; provider policy/budget, task checkpoint/effect and OAuth-transaction behaviour after restore; bad-migration detection and recovery by restoring a pre-migration backup
capabilities.knownLimitation: Local throwaway MariaDB 10.11 only; no managed database (Aiven) was touched, so the managed backup/restore path, PITR and real RTO/RPO are NOT verified. Rehearsal-sized data. Migrations are forward-only: there is NO schema downgrade; rollback = restore a pre-migration backup and writes after it are lost. The logical export is a rehearsal tool, not a replacement for the provider's managed backups. Backup/restore is not scheduled or automated.

capabilities.runtimePath: pnpm release:evidence consolidates unit/MySQL/E2E totals, eval + golden + recovery digests, migration consistency, capability truth, secret hygiene, source neutrality, production advisory counts and built-server smoke into reports/release/release-evidence.json bound to the git SHA; the quality-gate workflow's release-evidence job enforces it after validate, mysql-integration and e2e succeed
capabilities.knownLimitation: The workflow changes have NOT run on GitHub: the release-evidence job is CI_PENDING until a real Actions run on the exact head. A local run can only reach LOCAL_GATES_PASS_CI_PENDING; frozen install and typecheck are attested only by upstream CI job success. The manifest can never claim RUNTIME_VERIFIED and does not cover Render/Aiven staging, a live scanner, real-model quality, or production.
